public class Variant1 {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] fact;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        long pk = sc.nextLong();
        if (pk > N - 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        int k = (int) pk;
        fact = new long[N + 1];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % MOD;
        }
        long ans = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        int c = N - k;
        for (int i = c; i >= 0; i--) {
            long term = (choose(c, i) * pow(i, N)) % MOD;
            term = sign * term;
            ans = (ans + term + MOD) % MOD;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        ans = (ans * choose(N, c)) % MOD;
        if (k > 0) {
            ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long choose(int a, int b) {
        long num = fact[a];
        long den = (fact[b] * fact[a - b]) % MOD;
        return (num * inv(den)) % MOD;
    }

    static long pow(long x, int y) {
        long res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = (res * x) % MOD;
            x = (x * x) % MOD;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long inv(long a) {
        // Extended Euclidean algorithm
        long t = 0, newt = 1;
        long r = MOD, newr = a;
        while (newr != 0) {
            long quotient = r / newr;
            long temp = t - quotient * newt;
            t = newt;
            newt = temp;
            temp = r - quotient * newr;
            r = newr;
            newr = temp;
        }
        if (r > 1) throw new ArithmeticException("Not invertible");
        if (t < 0) t += MOD;
        return t;
    }
}
